strategy.thesis: EdTech innovation center and early-stage investor (via MindCET Capital) backing startups that radically improve the learning experience across the life cycle; the innovation arm of the Center for Educational Technology (CET/MATACH).

program.location: Yeruham and Tel Aviv, Israel (with on-site week in London, UK during Bett Show)

application.how_to_apply: Apply via the MindCET accelerator program page; three-step selection (application form, two online interviews, pitch).

summary.en: MindCET, founded in 2012 in Yeruham as the EdTech innovation arm of the Center for Educational Technology (CET/MATACH), is one of the world's first accelerators dedicated to education and learning. It runs an annual ~10-company accelerator and invests via MindCET Capital (~$200K pre-seed / ~$1M seed) in EdTech startups; it also founded the global GESAwards competition.
summary.local: מיינדסט (MindCET), שנוסדה ב-2012 בירוחם כזרוע החדשנות של מטח (המרכז לטכנולוגיה חינוכית), היא אחד המאיצים הראשונים בעולם המתמקדים בחינוך ובלמידה. היא מפעילה מאיץ שנתי של כ-10 חברות ומשקיעה דרך MindCET Capital בסטארטאפים בתחום האדטק.

strategy.thesis: First VC fund dedicated to ultra-Orthodox (Haredi) entrepreneurs in Israel, investing across EdTech, e-commerce, AI, cybersecurity and fintech; founded by the KamaTech team together with iAngels.

application.how_to_apply: Via KamaTech / 12A network; primarily focused on Haredi-founded startups.

summary.en: 12A Venture Capital (12Angels), launched in 2016 by KamaTech founders Moshe Friedman and Avrumy Weingot together with iAngels, was the first VC fund exclusively for Israeli ultra-Orthodox (Haredi) entrepreneurs. The ~$5M first fund targets ~30 companies in EdTech, e-commerce, AI, cybersecurity and fintech.
summary.local: 12A Venture Capital (12Angels), שהושקה ב-2016 על ידי מייסדי KamaTech ובשיתוף iAngels, היא קרן ההון סיכון הראשונה ליזמים חרדים בישראל. הקרן הראשונה בהיקף של כ-5 מיליון דולר מיועדת לכ-30 חברות בתחומי אדטק, מסחר אלקטרוני, בינה מלאכותית, סייבר ופינטק.

strategy.thesis: Accelerator and community bridging Israel's ultra-Orthodox (Haredi) community into the high-tech ecosystem; supports Haredi-founded startups across sectors including EdTech, and co-founded the 12Angels VC fund.

application.how_to_apply: Apply to the KamaTech accelerator program (Haredi entrepreneurs).

summary.en: KamaTech, founded in 2013 by Moshe Friedman with Zika Abzuk and Yossi Vardi, is an accelerator and community integrating Israel's ultra-Orthodox (Haredi) community into high-tech. Based in Bnei Brak, it selects ~8 startups from ~450 applicants annually across sectors including EdTech, and co-founded the 12Angels VC fund.

strategy.thesis: EdTech investment/innovation platform — 'not an accelerator or incubator but something in between' — and the external innovation arm of veteran Israeli EdTech firm Time to Know, nurturing early-stage startups in informal education (video tech, digital books, MOOC platforms, learning materials).

application.how_to_apply: Via Time to Know / EDvantage; focused on informal-education EdTech startups.

summary.en: EDvantage is the external innovation and investment arm of Time to Know, a veteran Ramat Gan-based Israeli EdTech firm. Described by CEO Yair Brosh as 'not an accelerator or incubator but something in between,' it supports early-stage (pre-seed/seed) startups in informal education — video tech, digital books, MOOC platforms and learning materials — both operationally and from an investment standpoint.
summary.local: EDvantage היא זרוע החדשנות וההשקעה החיצונית של Time to Know, חברת אדטק ישראלית ותיקה מרמת גן. מנכ"ל החברה יאיר ברוש מתאר אותה כ'לא מאיץ ולא חממה אלא משהו באמצע', והיא תומכת בסטארטאפים בשלבים מוקדמים בתחום החינוך הבלתי-פורמלי.

strategy.thesis: Israel's nationwide, independent EdTech business hub connecting Israeli education startups to investors, international markets and partners; activities include market research, international business development, conferences (Israel Education Summit / Israel EdTech Week), lobbying, fundraising and investment matchmaking.

application.how_to_apply: Engage via EdTech Israel hub, summit and community programs.

summary.en: EdTech Israel, established in September 2014 by Dr. Jacob (Yaki) Dayan, is Israel's nationwide, independent EdTech business hub. Based in Tel Aviv, it connects Israeli education startups to investors and international partners through market research, business development, conferences (Israel Education Summit / Israel EdTech Week), lobbying, fundraising and investment matchmaking.
summary.local: EdTech Israel, שהוקמה בספטמבר 2014 על ידי ד"ר יעקב (יאקי) דיין, היא מרכז עסקי ארצי ועצמאי לאדטק בישראל. ממוקמת בתל אביב, מחברת בין סטארטאפים חינוכיים ישראליים למשקיעים ושותפים בינלאומיים באמצעות מחקר שוק, פיתוח עסקי, כנסים, גיוס הון והזדמנויות השקעה.
